race.comment: SHE HAD A PLAN (7) goes on top in the opener and hails from the sharp Gollan stable and boasts strong pedigree substance as a full sister to Listed winner Gin Spirit. Has trialled sharply in readiness and keeps Ange Jones. CELESTIALMESSENGER (1) is a clear danger for Kelly Schweida. The Lucky Vega colt trialled well over the Doomben 840m and is expected to make his presence felt. GHOST GUM (2) has Ben Thompson, a low gate and hails from a family that has already produced winners. Must be considered. While ICONIC SCENES (3) has Maloney booked next door. Fitted with just the one trial and steps out for the Shailer camp, who has a good record with first starters. Keeping safe. SEJATA (4) best of the rest.

Live1.SchedulerNote: *P1 [Metropolitan] Meeting Transferred, Doomben to Eagle Farm
